finding.summary: After a workspace lock was acquired, renaming a workspace ancestor and replacing it with a symlink could redirect pathname-based review-state I/O into another valid learner workspace.

remediation.implementation: Lock-scoped workspace and state-directory descriptors now anchor reads and atomic replacements to the validated generation and revalidate the lexical parent before publication.
remediation.regression: test_locked_review_write_rejects_ancestor_swap_redirection reproduces the race and proves both original and attacker review logs remain unchanged.

claim_boundary: This record preserves the failed review. It is not a passing review receipt and cannot satisfy AC-24.
